purpose: Seed CUBE/Elohim/Gauntlet with bounded, falsifiable private-sector B2B sales hypotheses. This is not demand evidence, a live listing, a public silo, or revenue.

guardrails.default_acquisition: Inbound search intent, existing public requests, permitted directories/feeds, user-submitted RFQs, and authorized supplier data. No personal outreach or paid ads by default.

scoring.priority: P1 = fastest low-cost path to a buyer-supplied input and objective deliverable; P2 = useful but needs more data/process; P3 = longer-cycle or repeatability-dependent.
hard_gates: observable intent or real submitted request
reject_if: requires production writes while DB is unhealthy
savings or verification claims cannot be substantiated

hypotheses.name: Supplier quote normalization
hypotheses.job_to_be_done: Reduce comparison time and reveal scope gaps, exclusions, lead-time and landed-cost differences
hypotheses.fulfillment_contract: Buyer submits 2–10 quotes; structured comparison delivered with provenance and unknowns
hypotheses.demand_evidence_required: Search intent around compare supplier quotes; existing supplier quote worksheet; buyer explicitly supplies quotes
hypotheses.next_test: Find one attributable external request or buyer-submitted real case; offer a narrowly scoped paid pilot; require explicit willingness to pay before marking QUALIFIED_BUYER_INTENT.
hypotheses.kill_rule: Kill or revise if no traceable buyer intent, inputs cannot be lawfully obtained, output cannot be checked, or fulfillment effort exceeds the tested price.
